old.name: eden-big-top-canopy
old.description: The striped canvas canopy of a circus big top (24 m, red with white seams, a pennant on the king pole); sits on an enterable hall.

new.name: eden-big-top-canopy
new.description: The canvas of a circus big top: a red and white striped canopy (33 m) with a gold rim, a striped canvas skirt round the hall below, open at both doors, and a pennant on the king pole; sits on an enterable hall.

new.name: eden-cable-car
new.description: The alpine cable car as scenery: five steel pylons, two cables and a red and a yellow cabin from the valley station up to the mountain station (116 m). Placed at the valley station with its height given.

new.name: eden-bunting
new.description: A 10 m run of coloured bunting: fourteen pennants on a sagging cord between two wooden poles (3.2 m).

new.name: eden-stage-floor
new.description: A round painted stage floor (3.8 m) in eight bright segments with a white rim, laid on the ground for open-air music.
